remarks: Beautifully updated 2-bedroom and rare two FULL-bath townhouse offers comfort, convenience and tranquility. Freshly painted throughout. New flooring on main level and stairs. Updated full bathroom on each floor. Large, eat-in kitchen opens to patio overlooking perennial garden and completely fenced-in back yard. The second floor features two spacious bedrooms with ample closet space. The basement provides additional storage and laundry area leading to the garage. The location is convenient and commuter-friendly--just minutes to public transportation, schools, and shopping. This pet friendly community offers delightful amenities including two tennis courts, two playgrounds, and a pool, making it easy to enjoy an active yet low-maintenance lifestyle. Sold as-is.
